chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Musa ibn Bakr or 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, from his father.

That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed the salat of istisqa' as two rak'ahs, and he began with the salat before the sermon, and he said seven and five takbirs, and he recited aloud.

key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer performed in this rite
key_terms.ٱلْخُطْبَةِ: the sermon associated with the prayer

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform the salat of istisqa'?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the manner in which the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed the salat of istisqa'. It indicates that it is performed as two rak'ahs, that the salat precedes the sermon, that additional takbirs are said, and that the recitation is done aloud.
